title: Onboard nyx-14b v1.0: perf profiles + metadata + changelog automation
author: Claire Huang
commits: Add nyx v1.0 metadata and perf profiles
Enable changelog generation for model metadata changes
Update test vectors and CI matrix for quantized profiles
body: Motivation: Add support for nyx-14b v1.0 to the model registry with validated performance profiles and ensure changes are surfaced in release notes automatically. This PR includes: 1) model metadata (name, family, tokenizer, architecture, recommended quantization profiles), 2) validated perf profiles for common sequence lengths (128/512/1024) across supported GPU types, 3) tests and smoke scripts used during onboarding, and 4) automation in the changelog generator to include model registry metadata diffs so downstream release notes pick up model additions/metadata changes. Checklist: - [x] Add metadata and canonical config - [x] Perf profile run results attached - [x] Changelog automation updated and unit tested - [x] Docs page for nyx drafted - [x] CI green (matrix: py3.9, py3.11, quantized runs) Notes: Perf profiles are conservative (p99 latency target 95ms on A100-40GB with sequence=512, batch=1). We include a lightweight fallback profile for cpu-only inference. Changelog generator change: when model metadata files under models/ change, the generator now emits a structured entry under `models:` section with model name, version, and brief notes pulled from metadata.description. This aligns with the release notes format used by the Console and release UI. Testing: included end-to-end smoke tests that validate parsers and profile ingestion; CI matrix includes a synthetic perf validation step that runs in CI with quantized sample runs (fast simulated).
review_comments: Ravi Patel: Left a comment about the perf profile units, please confirm that token throughput is TPS (tokens/sec) not sequences. Author: Confirmed and updated profile to include 'unit': 'tokens/sec' where applicable.
Marta Kovač: Suggest adding a note about tokenization differences vs other models in docs. Author: Added docs note and linked to the tokenizer compatibility page.

Ethan Lee: CI flaked on the quantized runner once — re-run fixed it, recommend adding retry in CI for this job. Author: Added a single retry and increased timeout for quantized-run job in .github/workflows.
release_notes: Added nyx-14b v1.0 to model registry with recommended perf/quantization profiles and automated release-note generation for model metadata changes. See models/nyx for details.
